pyzor_path.description: Full path to the Pyzor command-line client binary.

servers.description: List of Pyzor collaborative servers to query for message fingerprints.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Pyzor server.

port.description: Port number of the Pyzor server.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a server response (optional).

database_path.description: Path to the local Pyzor database file (stores learned hits and metadata). Ensure it's writable by the service user.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug output to stderr. Use only for troubleshooting.

min_hits.description: Minimum number of collaborative hits required before a message is flagged as spam. Lower values increase sensitivity.

response_timeout.description: Global timeout (seconds) for server communication. Increase if network latency causes timeouts.

auto_discover.description: Enable DNS-based server discovery using pyzor.org's TXT records. Disable for private or air-gapped deployments.

trusted_servers_file.description: Optional path to a file containing a custom list of trusted Pyzor servers (one per line, host:port). Overrides auto_discovery if set.
